Credit cards · before and after

The eight that read badly or look too plain, redrawn the way the debit cards are. Credit cards keep their network mark (Visa, Mastercard, JCB) and the card's name top-right, as the app draws them today. (The "before" pictures show a serif font only because they were rendered outside the app.)

After
